cayman-islands.title: Flag of the Cayman Islands

colors.note: British Blue Ensign tradition; the Caribbean Sea.
The turtle and pineapple in the coat of arms.

desc:
- A Blue Ensign with the coat of arms of the Cayman Islands featuring a pineapple, turtle, and three stars
- The three stars represent the three islands: Grand Cayman, Cayman Brac, and Little Cayman
- **Construction:** a Blue Ensign (1:2) with the Union Flag in the upper-hoist canton
- The coat of arms (shield with wavy bands, turtle, pineapple) appears in the fly half
trivia:
- The Cayman Islands are a British Overseas Territory in the Caribbean
- The flag features the Union Jack and the territory's coat of arms
- Known for being a major international financial center
